title.en: An Act Fixing the Boundary Line Between the Municipalities of Allen and San Isidro Province of Samar
title.orig: An Act Fixing the Boundary Line Between the Municipalities of Allen and San Isidro Province of Samar

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1959/ra_2511_1959.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The boundary line between the municipalities of Allen and San Isidro, Province of Samar, shall be the center of the Mawo River up to the intersection of Mawo River and Igot River (San Ramon Creek), and from the center of the mount of Igot River to the intersection of Igot River and Binalabag Creek which runs eastward up to the boundary of the Municipality of San Jose.

The Municipality of San Isidro shall include the barrios of San Ramon, Erenas, San Juan, Palanit, Veriato, Acedillo, Tangolan, Buenavista, Among, Happy Valley, Caaguit-itan, Corocolab-og and Caglanipao.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 21, 1959.
